reason.connector_identity_stale: The saved destination connection has changed.
reason.ownership_unavailable: Ownership of accepted records could not be verified.
reason.successor_unavailable: This recording cannot currently be recreated or changed.
reason.source_basis_unavailable: The original saved recording rules could not be verified.
reason.successor_source_unavailable: The original recording rules are unavailable.
reason.lifecycle_unavailable: Current action availability is not confirmed.
reason.source_not_canonical: This recording needs its existing migration workflow.
reason.source_not_current: This is an older generation, not the current recording.
reason.successor_requires_applied: Prepare and apply the recording before changing it.
reason.successor_requires_removed: Remove the old settings before recreating them.
reason.stale_scope: These settings or available actions changed. Refresh and review again.
reason.canonical_required: This recording uses the existing migration workflow.
reason.historical_generation: This is an older generation; review the current generation.
reason.active_basic_unsupported: This active recording needs its existing migration workflow.
reason.source_definition_unavailable: The original immutable recording rules are unavailable.
reason.recording_not_removed: Remove the old settings before recreating them.
reason.source_draft_not_active: The saved draft differs from the active recording. Review the original applied rules before continuing.

next.review_lifecycle: Review the existing recording change or refresh its status.
next.review_connector: Check the saved connection in destination settings.
next.stop: You can stop new recording while investigating.
next.reload: Refresh the saved recording and try again.
next.recreate: Review a new recording based on the removed settings.

history.unavailable: History and pending counts are not confirmed. Refresh before continuing.
history.kept: Accepted records keep their original destination. SQL tables, history and receipts remain. Counts below use separate units; do not add them together.
history.no_applied: No applied revision is recorded for this generation.

remove.title: Remove these saved recording settings?
remove.keeps: This stops new recording and removes only the active settings. Accepted backlog continues to its original destination. SQL tables, recorded history and delivery receipts are kept.

stop.keeps: Stopping prevents new records. Already accepted backlog still goes to its original destination; SQL tables, history and receipts stay intact.

removed.title: Removed recordings ({{count}})
removed.note: Manage or recreate removed settings here. These are not new ordinary recordings.
